The frame's complementizer goes to the apodosis waw s008 rather than to הָיָה, because the ASV writes *that* at the head of the apodosis (rule 45); הָיָה keeps *it came to pass*.
*thereof* stays `added`: שָׁמַע carries no object morpheme, and rule 44 forbids folding a supplied object pronoun into the verb.
כְּ + infinitive recast as a finite temporal clause gives *when* to the preposition and *heard* to the infinitive (rule 52), the unit discontinuous around the subject phrase (rule 25).
